title: The Pub Quiz
summary: Paddy and Billy team up for a pub quiz, but their combined knowledge consists of two completely different versions of Irish history. Somehow, they win.

scenes.visual: Wide shot of the pub interior with quiz night setup. Camera slowly pans across tables with competing teams. Paddy and Billy sit at corner table with quiz sheets, both looking determined.
scenes.narration: Quiz night. Ancient rivalries meet modern trivia.

scenes.visual: Medium shot of Derek at the microphone as quiz master, adjusting his glasses with annoying enthusiasm. Bright pub lighting casts unflattering shadows on his face.

dialogue.line: Question one: When did Ireland gain independence?

scenes.visual: Close-up on Paddy's face as he leans forward eagerly, eyebrows raised, finger pointing up confidently.
Close-up on Billy's face, adjusting his collar defensively while shaking his head firmly.
Medium two-shot of Paddy and Billy facing each other across the table, both gesturing emphatically while other teams look on with confusion in the background.
Medium shot of Derek at microphone, looking confused but still cheerfully oblivious, holding his quiz cards awkwardly.
Extreme close-up reaction shot of both men's faces side by side, eyes wide with surprise and confusion.
Medium shot of Paddy and Billy looking at their answer sheet together, both pointing at different sections while nodding in agreement.

Wide shot of Derek announcing winners while Paddy and Billy stand together awkwardly holding a small trophy, other teams looking bewildered in background. Camera slowly zooms in on the unlikely victors.
Medium two-shot of Paddy and Billy raising pints together in celebration, trophy between them on the table, both grinning despite their confusion.
